basic_info.description: Fully occupied, 4-unit trophy building nestled in the heart of Lower Haight. This property features 1 studio, 1 one-bedroom, and 2 two-bedroom units, all thoughtfully remodeled in 2019. The interiors showcase a modern, sleek design with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and expansive windows flooding each space with natural light. The property is professionally managed, ensuring a seamless experience for the new owner. No evictions in the building. Roof, water heaters, and electrical panels were also included in the 2019 remodel.  An oversized 2-car tandem (1 leased, 1 vacant) garage and 3 large storage spaces (1 leased, 1 vacant), 4 bike racks, and a shared laundry room for tenants. Outside, you will find a lush but low-maintenance garden with a drip system and brick patio. Nestled right in between Hayes Valley, Duboce Triangle and Haight-Ashbury, the Lower Haight is a diverse area known for its vibrantly eclectic and laid-back personality. Located right on The Wiggle and if that weren't enough, several parks including the iconic Alamo Square, Duboce, Buena Vista, the Panhandle and Golden Gate Park are conveniently close. This is a great opportunity to step in and start generating income from day one! Walk Score: 98
